note: Official AOSP GSI binaries published by Google; vanilla (no GMS). Pinned from the verified Android 16 GSI release notes. Never committed; fetched and verified at build/run time by android/fetch-gsi.
fallback_plan: If the published build is 4K-aligned (boot fails to map LOAD segments on the 16K kernel), build AOSP once with PRODUCT_MAX_PAGE_SIZE_SUPPORTED:=16384 and PRODUCT_NO_BIONIC_PAGE_SIZE_MACRO:=true and pin that here with its own sha256.
